# Ashby Brewery

## Mashing

The Ashby mash starts with liquor heated to 65 degrees and the tun is left to stand for 60 minutes. A mash that cools below 60 degrees is run off.

## Hops

Ashby adds the bittering hops at the start of a 60 minute boil and the finishing hops in the hop back.

## Casks

Casks at Ashby are steamed for four minutes and then rinsed with cold water.
